notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Immortal Coil and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Activate Lantern of the Lost by paying {1}, tapping it and exiling it, exiling all cards from all graveyards and drawing a card.
Each opponent's Immortal Coil triggers, causing them to lose the game.
